scope: Local exact editable DFM candidate, acceptance and offline team contract verification; release identity belongs to integration

contract.comparison: same baseline revision and semantic route/process/material declarations; full exact before/after reports and all rule transitions
contract.acceptance: doc_apply or same-role team_apply_step with candidate_id, expected_revision, accept_dfm:true

failed_attempts.failure: Attempted mutation through const JSON find result
failed_attempts.correction: Build mutable arrays before setting the JSON object

failed_attempts.failure: Discovery still expected 83 tools; raw process JSON comparison treated canonical key ordering as a changed input
failed_attempts.correction: Discovery now expects 84; semantic comparison canonicalizes object keys while retaining array order and values

failed_attempts.failure: Offline team transport reused the same function call ID across rounds
failed_attempts.correction: Fixture emits distinct call IDs; actual same-role receipt and explicit acceptance path subsequently passed

observed_cases: Scratch exact 20x10x5 FDM box against declared 19x10x5 build volume: editable width 18 changes the envelope from incompatible to compatible while preserving exact live geometry/revision until acceptance
Before/after retain baseline revision, exact bounds, same caller process inputs and unknown slicer/strength evidence
Shared span parameter resolves FDM target but makes another CNC component's stock screen incompatible; both transitions remain visible
Sheet flange inner radius 1 to 3 mm resolves caller minimum radius 2 screen through an isolated exact editable candidate
Missing/false acceptance preserves geometry/revision; explicit true acceptance reuses evaluated geometry, increments one revision and creates one undo entry

Stale expected_revision, mismatched rule_version, absent/inapplicable/already-compatible recommendation, process relaxation, definition removal, material/density edit, no-op and unrelated parameter proposals reject
Failed exact geometry and required postconditions provide failure evidence and no retained candidate
Legacy display geometry cannot supply exact proposal authority
Cache eviction and changed document fingerprint at unchanged revision reject retained candidates without rebasing
Offline part-designer team retains the proposal recipe, rejects false acceptance and commits the accepted same-role candidate exactly once
Existing manufacturing, DFM rules, agent features/team and standalone MCP stdio tests pass
remaining_limits: Focused local evidence only; full release regression, hosted CI, packaging and deployment remain integration gates
Explicit acceptance flag is a host/API action; agents must first obtain the user's acceptance of the concrete edit as instructed by onboarding
Rule screening cannot establish function, cost savings, global design improvement or production qualification
No generic capability limits, mesh-based production geometry selection, CAM/slicer evidence or physical machine trials
Candidates use existing ephemeral five-minute/four-candidate/128 MiB cache limits and are not saved as new .ark schema
